entries: Both balloons preserve the visible meaning.
UP misread LIP changes concealment to a lip; FAN is a handheld fan in context, not a ventilator. Minor number-agreement change does not fix either error.
Stylized first clause is unreadable OCR and translation; final clause also wrongly renders LEFT as IZQUIERDA.
Threat using the father and its estimated duration retained.
All three balloons retain age, concern, and advantage.
First complete balloon correct; bottom dialogue continues outside capture. Visible full words are translated.
I DID missing; THAT? alone loses the actor and action.
Full question correct; bottom THEN is cut and unrecognized.
Both balloons preserve the prediction and question.
DEVOURING misread, devouring becomes destroying; getting stronger becomes strengthening the weak.
Left vertical KILL HIM not recognized; clipped top fragment also unrecognized. Other main paragraphs translated.
Condition, technique, number six and death retained.
USUAL SELF and DEMON omitted; contrast with normal behaviour loses its sense.
CAUGHT misread CALGHT and left untranslatable in second sentence.
Regrets and internal torment retained; second question understandable.
Complete GOOD GRIEF interjection omitted; both remaining propositions correct.
Visible continuation and initial question preserved despite BY misread.
TRUE qualification omitted from goodwill; both other propositions retained.
Main complete paragraph correct; preceding AT THE END fragment cut and unrecognized.
Risen to the seat of master mistranslated as physically rising to a headquarters; bottom continuation clipped.
First standalone WHY question merged away; remaining propositions retained.
EVEN emphasis omitted from full question; clipped top fragment unrecognized.
Before recovers HIS in Spanish despite malformed OCR; after leaves calibre S, losing the referent.
Past response and both adjectives retained.
I SEE acknowledgement rendered as literal VEO; title is also compressed.
Expel LS corrected to expel us; both readable balloons correct now. Top previous text only unreadable traces, so full-view approval withheld.
Named pill and silk, temporal contrast retained.
CONTINUE misread CONTINLE and left as continle; LEARN here means find out, not studying.
Question and both response sentences retained.
Worse, outward loyalty and inward ridicule retained.
Both visible propositions retained; sent off literal reading supported by source.
Energy, bottle, source and action retained.
First possessive expression becomes the people themselves; its omitted referent needs surrounding context. Second balloon correct.
Negation and both questions, including profanity, retained.
GO AND fused and untranslated; imperative regret becomes first-person LAMENTO with wrong actor.
All three balloons retain the requests, duration, training and answer.
Allegiance and conflict with father retained.
Question of abandoning leadership for one relationship retained; literal seat still intelligible.
JUST qualification omitted, while refusal and duel request retained.
Offer, anything else, please and anytime retained; stammer is expressive repetition.
SNAPS AT verbally becomes physical GOLPEA BRUTALMENTE.
YOU mangled in OCR; PODRIA shifts second-person COULD to first/third-person.
Entire LET'S GO A ROUND challenge omitted.
GROUND omitted and first balloon split into three disconnected translated fragments.
Both fully visible passages correct; cut OF COURSE line unrecognized.
Full question correct; first incomplete balloon loses clipped top line.
Obedience and contrast with unconventional master retained.
Control question and brother starting to meet people retained.
BEING lost in OCR; malformed Spanish loses the opening grammatical relation.
JUST temporal immediacy omitted; bottom exclamation translated but cut in original.
Personal introduction rendered as introduccion rather than presenting oneself; context is two brothers learning about each other.
Complete narrative retained. Exempt URGH groan wrongly becomes URGENCIAS, recorded as a separate SFX corruption.
Question and both looking at sky retained.
Second balloon has broken Spanish infinitive No estamos exactamente ir; last YOU person corrected, but whole viewport remains unapproved.
Clean out leader rendered as cleaning him; criminal underworld becomes inframundo.
Probability, ownership of flesh and being torn off retained.
MUST BE A missing; paragraph fragmented into disconnected translations.
USE, UNORTHODOX and FOLLOW misread and left as wrong untranslated words; bottom continuation clipped.
Question, major stronghold and named valley retained.
HERE location omitted from kidnapping request; remaining sentences correct.
Lunge and dagger lost/mangled in two disconnected fragments.
Broken Spanish construction loses usable meaning of dealing only with culprits; clipped BLUE fragment unrecognized.
Probability, first person, carriage and owner retained; FIRST already expresses first-ever sense.
Chosen method and madman retained; exempt laughter appropriately rendered.
All visible propositions translated; initial text cut at top.
Both visible propositions retained; first line cut at top. Changed register/pronoun in last question preserves sense.
Rat, first, and before discussing details retained.
Question, excluded person, six witnesses and sixth wolf retained.
